//: Declaration-only build of the Canvas SDK. The emitted .d.ts files ARE the authoring contract: the shell provisions them to ~/.klaus/canvas/sdk/, the canvas skill tells the model to read them before writing a canvas, and canvas_check validates every named import against what index.d.ts re-exports. Generating them from the implementation is what keeps those three consumers from drifting — a hand-written declaration set would go stale the first time a prop changed. Run via `npm run canvas:sdk-types`.
//exclude: Tests are not part of the authoring contract, and `types: []` above strips the bun/node globals they need — so including them would fail this build for a reason that has nothing to do with the SDK's public surface.
